suggestions.quote: Please add map search and area filters. The filter criteria have not been decided.
suggestions.title: Add Map Search and Area Filters
suggestions.description: The current design does not include map search and area filters. These features are essential for users to easily find and select specific areas on the map. The filter criteria have not been decided, so it's unclear what criteria will be used. This is a critical requirement that should be addressed to enhance user experience.
uncertainties: The exact criteria for the filters are not specified.
The map search and area filters may not be implemented as expected.
The current design does not provide a clear way to decide on the filter criteria.
